name: MASON
description: Multi-Agent Simulator Of Neighborhoods (MASON) is a fast, portable Java-based discrete-event multi-agent simulation library developed at George Mason University. It provides a lightweight core with optional 2D/3D visualisation and supports large-scale agent simulations in domains such as ecology, social science, and robotics.
reputation: Well-regarded in the ABM research community for its speed and flexibility; commonly used in academic publications on complex systems.
notes: Pure simulation library; no standardised benchmark tasks or scoring. Performance measured by simulation throughput and model fidelity.
